correctness.rationale: Every connected component of the free shift graph is a bi-infinite path, hence its maps are translations or reversals. Injective ordered-pair colors decode the input; translations then fix vertices and a reversal would impose x_{j+2}=x_j, impossible on the aperiodic set. Each of six unordered pair collisions admits a one-defect or step-sequence witness with an explicit reflection, so each noninjective rule fails for the whole graph. The six complete algebraic constructions work at all integer positions, not just tested ranges. Independent 256-rule, -35..35 finite checks confirmed the witnesses and 24 injective 4-color rules.
